work_title: In This Corner of the World (Kono Sekai no Katasumi ni)

places.name: Kure
places.connection: The city of Kure is depicted in the film as the primary setting where the protagonist Suzu lives.

places.name: Hiroshima
places.connection: Hiroshima is a significant location in the film, representing the broader impact of World War II on the region.

places.name: Shukkeien Garden
places.connection: The garden is featured in the film as a representation of the beauty and tranquility of Hiroshima before the war.

places.name: Yamato Museum
places.connection: The museum is related to the naval history depicted in the film, as Kure was a major naval base.
